title: Machine Learning Enhanced Graph-Based Anomaly Detection for Financial Transactions
dataset: IBM AML supplied 5K, split 42, complete 1,500-account held-out population
selection_rule: Top five by frozen E4 raw anomaly score, descending; Unicode lexical ID tie-break
label_policy: No held-out labels are loaded before selection; labels are metrics-only after every complete-population score is finalized
scoring: Frozen E4 model and Phase 5 CREST aggregation, alpha=beta=0.25
nonselected_fallback: E6_BASE empirical training-score calibrated E4 score
evaluation_population: All held-out accounts, identical for E4 and selective CREST modes
interpretation: Exploratory, score-selected and selection-biased; not equivalent to full-population CREST and not confirmatory
